title: Subgroup Assignment Manifest
description: Manifest for a per-sample subgroup assignment product. The assignment Parquet itself contains one row per (sample, subgroup_id) — this manifest indexes it in the catalog. Produced by subgroup_assigner_directly_tagged or subgroup_assigner_maf_filter methods (iter-1b) or subgroup_assigner_classifier_run (iter-2). Consumed by cards using --stratify-by subgroup_catalog. Lives at data-catalog/manifests/derived/subgroup-assignments/{indication}/{data_source}/{release_pin}/manifest.yaml.

data_source.description: Which data source's samples are assigned. iter-1b: tcga + depmap. genie = AACR GENIE registry MAF (per-sample mutation strata). genie_bpc = GENIE Biopharma Collaborative curated cohort (per-sample line-of-therapy + treatment strata; landed 2026-07-15). Tempus is excluded — pre-aggregated upstream, per-sample assignment not accessible.

release_pin.description: Catalog release_pin identifier (e.g., '2026-Q2'). Pins the catalog manifest version used as input.

subgroup_catalog_ref.description: Reference to the subgroup_catalog manifest used to generate these assignments (e.g., 'coadread-subgroups-2026-q2').

subgroup_catalog_content_pin.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the RESOLVED subgroup-catalog file content at generation time. The release_pin label (e.g. '2026-Q2') is a moving target — catalogs are edited in place under a fixed version label (COADREAD/2026-Q2 grew 6→18 strata across 5 in-place edits in 48h). This content-pin makes staleness detectable: an assignments product whose pin differs from the current catalog's hash was derived against a different stratum set, even if release_pin matches. Consumers and the coverage matrix compare this against a freshly-hashed catalog to flag re-emit-needed cells.

input_manifest_ids.description: Catalog manifest IDs the assigner method read (e.g., ['tcga-gdc-dr45-0', 'gdc-pancohort-somatic-dr45-0']).

assigner_method.description: Which method produced these assignments. iter-1b: directly_tagged + maf_filter. iter-2: classifier_run.

assigner_method_version.description: Semver of the assigner method at production time.

parquet_s3_uri.description: S3 URI to the assignment Parquet (or local file:// during development).

n_samples_total.description: Total number of distinct samples assigned. NOT row count of the Parquet — a sample may appear in multiple strata.

strata_summary.description: Per-stratum sample counts. Cross-checked against the catalog's expected_n_* fields when present.

canonical_decision_ref.description: Reference to canonical-decisions record gating this product.
